name: Publishing
description: Publishing to a connected Instagram account: feed photos, Reels, Stories and carousels, composed against a live preview of what the post will look like, then published immediately or put in a queue. A calendar of what is going out and when, a queue where failures are read and retried, and a library of everything already on the account. Scheduling runs on the deployment's own database when there is one — the Chatfuel API publishes immediately and has no scheduled-publish of its own — and the module works without it, composing and publishing on the spot.

permissions.requiredFor: reading the connected Instagram account and what it may do
publishing, and reconnecting the account when its permissions are short
